_notes: Role spell book for Staff of the Cracked Rune. Any two distinct elements resolve to the caster role's spell (id ELEMENTA_ELEMENTB_ROLE). Fields on each spell override the archetype; damage/status still come from elements[*].hit in spells.json, scaled by mult. Cooldown = spell.cd ?? shapes[shape].cd. Cost = elements × 8 × shapes[shape].cost.
